thread.title: UPLD, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG, CIEN, QTRH

author: MT Newswires
title: UPLD, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG, CIEN, QTRH
text:
CSCO: -0.02%
GOOG: -0.21%
Tech stocks were mostly lower in Thursday's mid-day trade, with tech stocks in the S&P 500 losing more than 0.2% in value and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was declining 0.3%.
Moving stocks include:
(+) Upland Software ( UPLD ) was advancing 4% after it acquired Adestra Ltd., a provider of enterprise-grade email marketing, transaction and automation software for $56 million in cash.
In other sector news:
(+) Ciena ( CIEN ) was up 8% as the network strategy and technology company posted fiscal Q4 adjusted earnings of $0.53 per share, up from $0.32 in the same period a year ago and exceeding the estimate of $0.48 from analysts polled by CapIQ.
(-) Quarterhill ( QTRH ) was slightly lower after its Wi-LAN unit said its wholly owned subsidiary, Collabo Innovations, has granted a non-exclusive license for OmniVision's CMOS image sensor products. OmniVision payment to Collabo and all other terms of the agreement are confidential, Wi-LAN added.
